$comment: What each design is, in Master Roachi's own words — the one part of a
product page that is not a number out of Printful.
Keyed by Printful product id, like the payment links in lib/site.ts and
for the same reason: the id survives a rename and the slug does not. One
string per paragraph. A product with no entry shows no section at all,
rather than a heading over an empty space, so missing is a supported
state and is normal for a product that has just been synced.
It lives here, in content/ rather than data/, because data/ is what the
build fetches and content/ is what he writes. It is JSON rather than MDX
because it is keyed by id and MDX collections are keyed by filename, and
a file called 464722916.mdx is not an improvement on anything.
lib/content.ts only ever reads *.mdx, so this file is invisible to the
content collections and will not turn up as a page.
464722916: It went first because it’s the one I finished first — there was no plan. Wear it if you think it looks cool, which is the entire qualification.
And if you really love me, you’d wear this.
Chest print only; the back is a plain shirt.
